fields.adminNotificationsNewVersion: Show notification when new Bidar CRM version is available
fields.adminNotificationsNewExtensionVersion: Show notification when new extension version is available

tooltips.ldapCreateEspoUser: This option allows Bidar CRM to create a user from LDAP.
tooltips.adminNotificationsNewVersion: Show notification to administrator when a newer Bidar CRM version is available.
tooltips.b2cMode: By default Bidar CRM is adapted for B2B. You can switch it to B2C.
tooltips.ldapUsername: The full system user DN which allows to search other users. E.g. "CN=LDAP System User,OU=users,OU=bidarcrm,DC=test,DC=lan".
tooltips.ldapBaseDn: The default base DN used for searching users. E.g. "OU=users,OU=bidarcrm,DC=test,DC=lan".
tooltips.ldapUserLoginFilter: The filter which allows to restrict users who are able to use Bidar CRM. E.g. "memberOf=CN=bidarGroup,OU=groups,OU=bidarcrm,DC=test,DC=lan".
tooltips.siteUrl: A URL of this Bidar CRM instance. You need to change it if you move to another domain.
